release: Local release candidate; production configuration pending

findings.change: Versioned future-leg amendments retain departed legs/sequence and old costs. Mid-transit cancellation records disposition; explained settlement remains possible.
Atomic supplier/invoice registry rejects normalized duplicate identity, including concurrent posting.
Vendor accounts link to legal supplier organizations; generated bills and AP identify the supplier.
findings.evidence: All vendor bill scenarios; AP controls

findings.change: Declarations, holds, supporting evidence and export/import release gates are enforced.
Structured UN/name/class/packing/regulation data, signed support and verified acceptance block unsafe dispatch.
Mode-specific documents, valid MAWB stock, master/house links, manifests and immutable approved/issued PDF copies.
Vehicles/drivers/trips validate expiry, capacity and availability; road arrival and trip closure precede completion.
Independent document currencies, dated FX, AED postings, chosen journals and realized FX gains/losses.
findings.evidence: S22; six-currency credit and payment controls

findings.change: Temperature requirements and instructions survive quotation conversion.
Unit-aware OOG detection requires permits, equipment, engineering/lashing acceptance and evidence.
Unit-aware volume, gross weight, 1:6000 air chargeable weight, sea W/M and container TEUs.
findings.evidence: Physical assertions in every scenario; unit cases

findings.change: Customer projections and tables omit buy rates, buy FX/currency and supplier-private notes/metadata.
findings.evidence: Published-quotation assertions in all scenarios; Chrome client checks

findings.change: Consignments and signed PODs enforce booked, partially delivered and remaining quantities before completion.
Sealed masters link multiple houses, master/house B/Ls and manifests; one shared bill allocates exact costs.
findings.evidence: S03; shared one-cent allocation unit test

findings.change: Groupage masters carry multiple houses/consignees, shared cost shares and individual delivery evidence.
Issuer/customer snapshots, tax treatment, supply date, credits and AED equivalent fields render in legal-profile-aware PDFs. Production legal configuration remains required.
findings.evidence: S06/S22; credit controls; rendered PDF review

findings.change: Setpoint/range/equipment, readings, excursion rejection and explained resolution are linked to each leg.
Net weight above gross is rejected; package dimensions/counts and numerical precision are checked.
Planned and actual date pairs reject reversed chronology.
Receipts, bin/cross-warehouse transfers and dispatch use locked non-negative stock balances and cargo quantity limits.
Payments require an active selected bank/cash journal; AED carrying balances and settlement differences are explicit.
Legacy entry redirects into the current workspace; historical tables remain preserved.
Active valid route-matched tariffs apply to charges using physical measurement bases.
Cumulative source/base net and VAT allocation consumes residual cents on full reversal.
findings.evidence: Six-currency API reversals; 250 arbitrary unit sequences

findings.change: Search updates on input and preserves focus/caret, so the first record click works.
findings.evidence: Every browser record open uses search then one click
